title: GRYPHON’S SALES ANALYTICS
summary: Turning scattered sales signals into a clear view of what needs attention

children: Turning scattered sales signals into a clear view of what needs attention

attrs.alt: Gryphon sales analytics dashboard showing performance and calling activity

children: Sales leaders were monitoring performance, productivity, data quality and missing deals across disconnected dashboard signals. During my co-op, I used workflow walkthroughs with sales stakeholders to understand how they scanned performance and investigated exceptions. I then extended the existing dashboard with reusable KPI, visualization, filtering and interaction patterns that helped teams identify what required attention first.

I designed reusable KPI, metric-card, calendar and data-visualization patterns for Gryphon’s existing MicroStrategy dashboard, helping sales leaders and Sales Ops scan pipeline, quota and at-risk deal signals.
These additions made performance, productivity, data-quality and missing-deal signals easier to scan, compare and act on within the existing dashboard.
The reconstructed diagrams below show how the added components turned raw activity into prioritized attention without exposing proprietary screens.
Design for recognition at a glance
Structured charts for rapid comparison so leaders could recognize performance movement before drilling into detail.
Elevated errors and missing-deal signals so problems surfaced before manual review was required.
Kept location and territory controls beside the charts they affected so every change remained understandable.
Scale the system, not the screen count
Created draggable, resizable modules that supported new analytics views without rebuilding the dashboard each time.
